commits.summary: Example 290: fixed-security is established beside the route at the frozen bound, mutant-security is queued after its probe refuted it, and the page says where the other two stand (verification pending)
commits.body:
Example 290 (CVE-2023-34035, Spring Security 5.8.4 to 5.8.5). Job 20261116-225709-example-290-fixed-security-through-the-a passed: the frozen security claim is established on 5.8.5 at the bound of 8, through the adapter entry, in 6.9 s (659 paths, 8,509 variables, 131 MiB). target.json records it as the task's besideRoute answer; changes.py still lists the example as to prove, since three tasks are open. The verdict rests on three library initializers observed on a JVM in place of run by the checker (Spring's ClassUtils, the servlet API's GenericServlet and HttpServlet), which the outcome states and the page explains: weaker evidence than an initializer the checker ran, and said so.

mutant-security: an inline probe at the frozen bound refuted the claim on the mutant in 6.1 s, on select(servlets=[1, 0], method=0, patterns={}) returning 0, run on a JVM; the mutant's JAR is byte for byte the one the mutant replay ran. Queued as 20261116-231724-example-290-mutant-security-through-the, and not recorded as decided until that job is in. What it needed since the last commit: Arrays.asList(T...) as a model for the checker alone (lib/models/java/util/lists/ArrayAsList.java: a view of its array with size, get and toArray(), compiled against the JDK's List in a run of its own) and Collections.emptyMap() as the JDK's one empty map, with their evidence in lib/tests/claims.rs (claims.M#listed and #emptied, in the checker on every input of a bound and on a JVM). Those files of lib/ are in the commit before this one, pptopklk: the pipeline's commit of collected results took a snapshot of the shared working copy while they were being written.

vulnerable-security has no verdict: the checker stops, by name, at new ArrayList(int) in createMvcMatchers, and 5.8.4 collects its matchers in ArrayLists on every path. A model of ArrayList written in this session gave the expected witness on 5.8.4 (select(servlets=[0, 0], method=0, patterns={}) returns 0, run on a JVM) and was taken out again before any commit: lib/tests/conformance.rs and lib/tests/values.rs record ArrayList as a class with no model and the contract library holds a contract for ArrayList(int), so making it a model changes recorded verdicts, which is a step to make and review on its own. preservation is not attempted; it needs that model, the matchers' constructors, and --observed-initializer for equivalence. The page (README.md), target.json's handoff and the blockers' notes say all of this.

commits.summary: Example 290: mutant-security is refuted beside the route at the frozen bound, on a servlet registered before the DispatcherServlet
commits.body:
Job 20261116-231724-example-290-mutant-security-through-the passed: the frozen security claim of example 290 (CVE-2023-34035) is refuted on the constructed mutant of Spring Security 5.8.5, which looks at the first registration only, in 5.9 s (708 paths, 15,905 variables, 190 MiB). The witness is select(servlets=[1, 0], method=0, patterns={}), which returns 0 and throws nothing, run in the harness on a JVM; the mutant's JAR is byte for byte the one the mutant replay ran. target.json records it as the task's besideRoute answer, and the page, the verdict label and the notes say two of the four proof tasks are decided: the claim established on 5.8.5 and refuted on the mutant, both through the adapter entry, beside the route. vulnerable-security (no verdict: the checker has no model of ArrayList, which 5.8.4 collects its matchers in) and preservation (not attempted) stay open, as the page and target.json's handoff describe.

Verified by: validate_example.py 290 (passed); changes.py 290 (the example stays listed as to prove); and the default test run on the state of the previous commit plus these files: default tier, 48 of 48 passed. The proof tier after this cycle's engine changes (20261116-231725-the-proof-tier-after-example-290-s-engin) is still running.
